build_gradient_checkpointing_wrapper: build a gradient checkpointing wrapper around a Penzai layer to reduce memory usage during training
create_checkpointed_layer: create a Checkpointed wrapper that applies JAX gradient checkpointing to a Penzai neural network layer
apply_checkpointing_to_attention: apply gradient checkpointing to Attention layers in a Penzai model using pz.select and pz.apply
run_stateless_call_with_checkpointing: run a stateless layer call wrapped in jax.checkpoint to rematerialize gradients during backpropagation
configure_checkpointing_policy: configure an optional checkpointing policy function on a Checkpointed wrapper to control rematerialization granularity
